version.notes: Requires a published GitHub release, not just a manifest version.

build.notes: WORKFLOW_FILE is the actual filename under .github/workflows/, including its extension.

youtube.notes: Requires a verified channel ID, not a video ID or @handle.

discord.notes: Requires the server ID and an enabled server widget for member counts; use the actual invite URL.

linkedin.notes: Use the verified personal or company profile URL. This badge is text-only.

npm_downloads.notes: Include only for an existing, verified npm package.

pypi_downloads.notes: Include only for an existing, verified PyPI package.

usage.selection: Include only badges supported by verified project data. Three to five status badges is the sweet spot when supported; group social badges separately.
usage.placeholders: Replace all {{PLACEHOLDER}} markers with verified values and URL-encode each substituted URL component. For complete URL placeholders, preserve the verified URL instead of encoding the whole URL.
usage.static_text: For static badge text, double literal hyphens and underscores before URL encoding; do not apply this escaping to destination URLs.
usage.rendering: Render each entry as [![Label](url)](link). Omit badges with unresolved required values. Only YouTube and Discord social badges here display live counts.
